scope: Independent read-only recomputation of reported qualification, lock/selection provenance, fresh probe metrics, and stratified vector reconstruction. No fit or prediction calls.

lock_and_split_findings.selection: Each stored checkpoint is the earliest minimum of the nine VAL evaluations, validated against saved checkpoint metadata. All five complete TRAIN schedules regenerate to the same hash.
lock_and_split_findings.temporal_evidence_limit: diagnostic_opened.json has no wall-clock field; order is supported by its hash binding to the completed lock, frozen source control flow, and stage sequence, not an independent timestamp for every operation.

interpretation_limits: One paired training seed17 and 24 fresh base families: qualification is established within this diagnostic, not a multi-seed method claim.
K2_complete_accuracy aggregates native and fixed-age conditions; the condition gates separately require native accuracy, fixed-role accuracy, flip accuracy and MSE separation.
Probe 100% concerns local payload/tag availability; shuffle controls remain above chance for some heads and are not a permutation-null test.
Uniform intervention uses the original trained checkpoint; it is not a separately trained sixth architecture.
Capacity control failing weakens a parameter-count-only explanation, but distinct architectures also change optimization and inductive bias.
